ARTICLES OF ORGANIZATION
OF
LAUREL RIDGE PROVISIONS, LLC

A Colorado Limited Liability Company

Filed pursuant to Section 7-80-204 of the Colorado Limited Liability Company Act, C.R.S. Title 7, Article 80

ARTICLE I. NAME

The name of the limited liability company is Laurel Ridge Provisions, LLC.

ARTICLE II. PRINCIPAL OFFICE

The street address of the principal office of the limited liability company is 1425 Larimer Street, Suite 302, Denver, Colorado 80202. The mailing address is the same.

ARTICLE III. REGISTERED AGENT AND REGISTERED OFFICE

The name of the registered agent is Corvid Registered Agents, Inc., a Colorado corporation. The street address of the registered agent's registered office is 1600 Broadway, Suite 1200, Denver, Colorado 80202. The mailing address of the registered office is the same. The registered agent has consented to the appointment.

ARTICLE IV. MANAGEMENT

The limited liability company is manager-managed. The name and mailing address of each initial manager is:

Ruth Kalinowski, 1425 Larimer Street, Suite 302, Denver, Colorado 80202.
Devin Aguirre, 1425 Larimer Street, Suite 302, Denver, Colorado 80202.

ARTICLE V. DURATION

The limited liability company has perpetual duration.

ARTICLE VI. PURPOSE

The limited liability company is organized to engage in any lawful business, purpose, or activity for which a limited liability company may be organized under the Colorado Limited Liability Company Act.

ARTICLE VII. LIMITATION OF LIABILITY OF MANAGERS

To the fullest extent permitted by the Colorado Limited Liability Company Act, no manager of the limited liability company is liable to the company or its members for monetary damages for breach of fiduciary duty as a manager, except for liability for a breach of the duty of loyalty, for acts or omissions not in good faith or involving intentional misconduct or a knowing violation of law, or for a transaction from which the manager derived an improper personal benefit. Any repeal or modification of this Article does not adversely affect any right or protection of a manager existing at the time of the repeal or modification.

ARTICLE VIII. INDEMNIFICATION

The limited liability company shall indemnify each manager and officer to the fullest extent permitted by the Colorado Limited Liability Company Act, and may advance expenses to a manager or officer on receipt of an undertaking to repay the advance if it is ultimately determined that the person is not entitled to indemnification.

ARTICLE IX. TRUE NAME AND MAILING ADDRESS OF THE PERSON FORMING THE COMPANY

Ruth Kalinowski, 1425 Larimer Street, Suite 302, Denver, Colorado 80202.

ARTICLE X. EFFECTIVE DATE

These Articles of Organization are effective on the date and at the time of filing with the Colorado Secretary of State.

NOTICE

Causing this document to be delivered to the Secretary of State for filing constitutes an affirmation under penalties of perjury that the facts stated in it are true and that the individual causing delivery is authorized to do so, as required by Section 7-90-303 of the Colorado Revised Statutes.

The individual causing this document to be delivered for filing is Ruth Kalinowski, 1425 Larimer Street, Suite 302, Denver, Colorado 80202.
